title: Seriously Single Too
plot_overview: Two best friends plan to take on the party scene together, but their friendship faces a challenge when one friend’s boyfriend unexpectedly proposes. The sudden change tests their shared plans and brings their biggest fear to the surface.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this if you like stories about close friends, shifting plans, and navigating big relationship changes; Not for you if you want action, detailed reviews, or a plot description with more specifics.
